purpose: Paired one-factor test of whether flank Wells maturing before a full-perimeter pincer establishes control causes its observed pickup-to-bank conversion failure.
baselineEvidence: arc-relay-tapline-opening-matrix-v8: the pincer reached the opponent half with all eight bodies but was cross-matchup dominated, with median first pickup 69, median first bank 156.5, and 1.96 mean banks.
geometryRejection: The frozen pincer explicitly authors the complete outer perimeter, so a wall opening cannot shorten ingress without rewriting the candidate. Exhaustive rotationally symmetric wall-pair removal reduced the terrain-only enemy-Well-to-reactor shortest path by at most one tile. Geometry therefore cannot isolate the measured conversion delay.

factor.baseline: tapline-3: centre first birth 25; north/south first birth 50
factor.probe: tapline-flank-delay-25: centre unchanged at 25; north/south first birth 75
factor.heldConstant: map, objectives, cadence, scheduled rounds, classes, signatures, combat, collision policy, candidates, composition, seeds, and side assignments

entrants.label: Direct Mid
entrants.intent: Stay together, win the shortest centre Core race, then maintain moving pressure around whichever known Core can be converted through the shortest path.

entrants.label: Distributed Wells
entrants.intent: Field a continuous 3-3-2 economy across all Wells and release at most one local worker per remembered loose Core.

entrants.label: Four-plus-four Pincer
entrants.intent: Send two self-sufficient four-body wings through the full outer corridors, contest the enemy Well from both sides, and convert any Core either wing wins.

entrants.label: Split Interception
entrants.intent: Watch both outer corridors with paired interceptors, screen centre, and keep a home logistics pair active around the own Well.

evaluation.design: six fresh seed blocks, pincer against each opponent, both side assignments, same cells under baseline and probe
evaluation.outcomesAre: a paired causal probe, not a balance verdict
evaluation.mechanismSupport: probe raises pincer mean banks by at least 1.0 and aggregate point rate by at least 0.10 without increasing horizon share or reducing minimum value bodies
evaluation.decision: keep the profile only if the registered mechanism support is met; otherwise reject the lever and retain Tapline-3 unchanged
